title: Strings that YAML 1.1 reads as numbers
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema reads these as strings. YAML 1.1 reads them as numbers: integers with underscores, base-60 integers and floats such as `1:30`, binary integers, and hexadecimal integers with a sign. As strings they are quoted. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
